title: Engineering Simplicity: Simple Mechanism Interfaces Steer LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.36365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can interaction formats and textual scaffolds help large language model (LLM) agents make better decisions, and do better decisions come with better explanations? We study these questions in auctions and matching, multi-agent environments with explicit rules and known optimal strategies. These settings let us vary how a decision problem is presented while retaining a benchmark for evaluating behavior. Drawing on human-motivated theories of simplicity, we compare interfaces that elicit a complete bid or ranking with sequential interfaces that make safe choices easier to identify. We then hold the interaction format fixed and vary reasoning scaffolds and rule descriptions. Across four model families, the ascending auction interface substantially reduces bid deviations. translated_title: 工程化简单性：简单机制界面引导大语言模型智能体
translated_abstract: 交互形式与文本支架能否帮助大语言模型（LLM）智能体做出更好的决策，而更好的决策是否伴随着更好的解释？我们在拍卖与匹配这两类具有明确规则和已知最优策略的多智能体环境中研究这些问题。这些设定使我们能够在保留评估行为基准的同时，改变决策问题的呈现方式。借鉴源于人类认知的简单性理论，我们比较了引出完整出价或完整排序的界面，与让安全选择更容易识别的序列式界面。随后，我们固定交互形式，仅改变推理支架和规则描述。在四个模型家族上的实验表明，升价拍卖界面显著减少了出价偏差。匹配实验的比较还说明了为何序列式响应需要采用与完整排序不同的错误核算方式。清晰地列出收益条件并解释为什么真实（出价）策略更优，同样有助于改善智能体的决策表现。
tldr: 在拍卖与匹配等规则明确的多智能体环境中，简单化的机制界面（如升价拍卖和序列式界面）能显著引导LLM智能体做出更优决策，这一效果在四个模型家族中一致成立。
en_tdlr: Simpler mechanism interfaces, such as ascending auctions and sequential formats, substantially steer LLM agents toward better decisions in auctions and matching, a result that holds consistently across four model families.
